facts.text: The resort is positioned on Montenegro's Adriatic coastline, about an hour's drive from Dubrovnik, Croatia.
facts.excerpt: Our storied palace is positioned on Montenegro's Adriatic coastline, just an hour's drive from Dubrovnik, Croatia.

facts.text: The resort sits at the entrance to Boka Bay in Herceg Novi.
facts.excerpt: One&Only Portonovi sits at the entrance to Boka Bay in Herceg Novi, famed for its sapphire-blue waters, charming medieval towns and cinematic mountain ranges.

facts.text: Boka Bay is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its Venetian architecture.
facts.excerpt: positioned at the entrance to Boka Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site rich in natural beauty, local culture and rare Venetian architecture.

facts.text: The resort was designed by architect Jean-Michel Gathy.
facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned architect Jean-Michel Gathy, our Adriatic resort blends contemporary elegance with Montenegrin heritage

facts.text: The design blends contemporary style with Montenegrin heritage through local craftsmanship, fireplaces and a palette inspired by the surrounding landscape.
facts.excerpt: blends contemporary elegance with Montenegrin heritage through local craftsmanship, roaring fireplaces and a soothing palette inspired by the surrounding landscape.

facts.text: The resort is EarthCheck Gold Certified.
facts.excerpt: EarthCheck Gold Certified, our resort is committed to reducing its environmental footprint

facts.text: Transfers can be arranged by land or sea, with car and boat transfers from the region's airports and marinas.
facts.excerpt: Luxury transfers can be arranged by land or sea, with car and boat transfers available from the region's surrounding airports and marinas.

facts.text: Tivat airport is approximately 22 km from the resort and Dubrovnik airport approximately 30 km.
The resort is a base for day trips to Dubrovnik.
facts.excerpt: making our beach resort the perfect base for day trips to Dubrovnik and beyond.

facts.text: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi service is available throughout the resort.

facts.text: Dogs up to 12kg are welcome in designated outdoor areas, kept on a leash or in a crate.
facts.excerpt: Dogs up to 12kg are welcome in designated outdoor areas and must be kept on a leash or in a crate at all times.

facts.text: The sea is warm enough to swim from May to October.
facts.excerpt: the sea is warm enough to swim from May to October.

facts.text: Smoking is permitted only in designated outdoor areas, not indoors.
facts.excerpt: Smoking is not permitted in any indoor areas and is allowed only on open terraces and in exterior spaces.

facts.text: The resort describes itself as the jewel of Montenegro's new riviera.
facts.excerpt: One&Only Portonovi is the jewel of Montenegro's flourishing new riviera, which promises pristine beaches, sun-soaked sailing and hushed forest hiking.
